vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #2066 — deterministic umbrella:current-shape render

narratives.Description: Implement task umbrella:current-shape <N> as a native deft-ts verb that fetches the canonical ## Current shape comment via REST (scm shim) and prints or validates it — without reading the stale issue body.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Add packages/core/src/umbrella-current-shape/; register umbrella-current-shape CLI verb and umbrella:current-shape Taskfile alias; update AGENTS.md #1152 v1 note and agents-entry.md; tests for found/not-found/--json/section-detection.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent reporting umbrella status, I want a deterministic command that yields the live current-shape comment so I never conclude status from the pass-1 body alone.

items.title: Given issue N with a current-shape comment, when task umbrella:current-shape N runs, then it prints the comment body without reading the issue body.

narrative.Acceptance: Given issue N with a current-shape comment, when task umbrella:current-shape N runs, then it prints the comment body without reading the issue body.

items.title: Given no current-shape comment, when the verb runs, then it exits 1 with an actionable message (no body fallback).

narrative.Acceptance: Given no current-shape comment, when the verb runs, then it exits 1 with an actionable message (no body fallback).

expected_outputs: task umbrella:current-shape <N> yields live current shape

references.title: Issue #2066: Agents conclude umbrella status from issue body
